title: iFeST: An Iterative Motion Correction Framework for Fetal Brain Diffusion MRI via Frequency-Spatial-Temporal Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2611.30131v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fetal brain diffusion magnetic resonance imaging (dMRI) is a pivotal non-invasive tool for assessing the development of brain connectivity and microstructure. However, the prolonged acquisition times and complex sampling requirements render dMRI highly susceptible to unpredictable fetal motion. Existing motion correction methods typically process each dMRI volume independently and focus on inter-slice motion. Such strategies fail to utilize the coherent information between dMRI volumes along different diffusion directions and lack the ability to restore the intra-slice corruption. To address these limitations, we proposed iFeST, an iterative framework that combines frequency (k-space), spatial, and temporal (inter-slice) modeling for fetal brain dMRI motion correction. At each iteration, iFeST integrates information across diffusion directions into fiber orientation distributions (FODs). These distributions encode local fiber orientation

translated_title: iFeST：一种基于频率-空间-时间建模的胎儿脑部扩散MRI迭代运动校正框架
translated_abstract: 胎儿脑部扩散磁共振成像（dMRI）是评估大脑连接性与微结构发育的关键无创工具。然而，较长的采集时间和复杂的采样要求使dMRI极易受到不可预测胎儿运动的影响。现有的运动校正方法通常独立处理每个dMRI体数据，且仅聚焦于层间运动。这类策略无法利用不同扩散方向之间dMRI体数据的一致性信息，也缺乏恢复层内图像损坏的能力。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了iFeST——一个结合频率（k空间）、空间和时间（层间）建模的迭代框架，用于胎儿脑部dMRI运动校正。在每次迭代中，iFeST将跨扩散方向的信息整合到纤维方向分布（FODs）中，这些分布编码了局部纤维方向……
tldr: 该论文提出iFeST迭代框架，通过融合频率（k空间）、空间与时间建模，同时校正胎儿脑部扩散MRI中层间与层内的不可预测胎儿运动伪影，突破了以往方法独立处理各体数据且仅关注层间运动的局限。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes iFeST, an iterative motion correction framework for fetal brain diffusion MRI that jointly addresses inter-slice and intra-slice fetal motion by combining frequency (k-space), spatial, and temporal modeling, overcoming prior methods that independently process each volume and ignore inter-directional coherent information.
